text:
{collection}.{field}: marked personal.
Its earlier values are in the log under the space key only; erasing a person would not reach them.
Add a new personal field instead, and deprecate {collection}.{field}.
when: Under the lock's name, when `ncdb model build` or `ncdb model check` refuses the change against the previous lock, and in the error of opening with a lock the database refuses against the one it was last opened with: an existing field is marked personal.
